Name: The Shade
TraitText: For 1.5s after any dash he slips straight through the horde.
Bio: The original reaper: a hooded shadow that drifts above the grass and reaps with a long, patient scythe.
Tip: Dash into the crowd, slash, and dash out the other side - nothing can hold him for 1.5s.

Name: Gutsy Gus
TraitText: Runs up to 22% faster the fuller his soul sack.
Bio: A wiry ghoul courier who has never once been late, hunched over and flinging bones on the run.
Tip: Spend all three bone charges, then keep moving while they refill. A full sack makes him faster.

Name: Ondine the Wailing
TraitText: A ghost: the horde never blocks her path.
Bio: A wailing ghost in a trailing veil who floats over the ground and freezes crowds with her voice.
Tip: Float straight through the horde to line up a shriek, then sink the pack into the whirlpool.

Name: Gravus the Unfallen
TraitText: Standing still for 0.6s, he takes 25% less damage.
Bio: A towering armoured zombie warrior with horns and a battered round shield. He does not retreat.
Tip: Plant your feet: standing still makes him tougher, and Shield Up protects the whole crew.

Name: Old Mother Murk
TraitText: With a reaper within 700 she takes 20% less damage.
Bio: A squat, long-armed bog hag with a lantern on a crooked pole and pockets full of swamp.
Tip: Stay near the crew - she is sturdier with company - and drop Swamp Dawn where everyone fights.

Name: Imhotet
TraitText: For 2s after an E or R he runs 25% faster.
Bio: A tall, stiff mummy whose loose bandages lash out like whips. Every grab winds him up for the next.
Tip: Chain Bandage Grabs within 4.5s to stack +30% each; the speed after each cast keeps the chain going.

Name: Snig
TraitText: With 6 or more enemies pressing in he scrambles 20% faster.
Bio: A tiny red imp with a huge head, huge hands and no sense of danger. Everything he throws explodes twice.
Tip: Throw firecrackers into the thick of it; every third ability echoes. Getting swarmed makes him faster.

Name: Rufus Moonfang
TraitText: After 0.8s on the move he drops to all fours: +20% speed.
Bio: A hulking, hunched werewolf with enormous arms who runs on all fours when he means it.
Tip: Pounce on the toughest enemy to mark it, then run it down - keep moving to stay on all fours.

Name: Bolt Patchwork
TraitText: On the move he shoulders the horde aside.
Bio: The biggest reaper by far: a stitched-together brute with tiny head, huge hands and a lightning rod.
Tip: Walk straight through: he shoves the horde out of his path. Live Wire locks the worst ones in place.

Name: Count Ledgerdrain
TraitText: Below 40% health he turns to mist and walks through the horde.
Bio: A tall, elegant vampire count in a high-collared cape who hits harder the more souls he hoards.
Tip: Carry a heavy sack for damage; when it goes wrong, his mist form lets him walk out of the crowd.

Name: Granny Nettle
TraitText: With no reaper within 1200 she flits 20% faster.
Bio: A bent old witch with a tall crooked hat who heals friends and poisons everyone else.
Tip: Scout ahead alone at speed, then fly back and lob potions where the crew needs healing.

Name: Jack Gourdling
TraitText: For 1.2s after a dash he rolls 30% faster.
Bio: A spindly vine-bodied pumpkin man with a glowing carved head twice the size of his body.
Tip: Dash, roll, dash again: his dashes leave burning pulp and every dash gives a burst of speed.

Name: Granite Gil
TraitText: Holding still for 1s, he deals 25% more damage.
Bio: A crouching stone gargoyle with wide wings and heavy claws, happiest on a high spot watching.
Tip: Find a safe perch, stop for a second, and snipe the marked targets with Wing Gust.

Name: Big Brisket
UnlockHint: Beat a mission boss below 10% HP
TraitText: Below 40% health he takes 30% less damage.
Bio: A barrel-shaped butcher with tiny legs, huge forearms and a hook on a chain.
Tip: Fight hurt: he hits harder and takes less as his health drops. Meat Hook heals him back up.

Name: Ledger Mothwick
UnlockHint: Win with every objective done and nobody downed
TraitText: Within 1600 of a lantern she flutters 30% faster.
Bio: A small floating moth auditor in a stiff collar, fussing over every soul with a rubber stamp.
Tip: Stay close to the lantern trail - she is much faster near it - and let audits pay out extra souls.

Name: Hayward Crowe
TraitText: With 6 or more enemies around him he takes 25% less damage.
Bio: A lanky scarecrow with arms that never stop swinging and a flock of crows on his shoulders.
Tip: Drop the Straw Decoy to drag the horde off a friend; when crowded, the straw soaks the hits.

Name: Doc Stitches
UnlockHint: Carry 10 skulls back to the lantern
TraitText: While any reaper is down he runs 40% faster.
Bio: A hunched mad doctor in a white coat with wild white hair and a jumper cable in each hand.
Tip: When someone drops, sprint to them; It's Alive! revives everyone near him at once.

Name: Mortimer Crepe
TraitText: The fuller his sack, the sturdier: up to 25% less damage.
Bio: A very tall, very thin undertaker in a top hat who measures every grave by eye.
Tip: Lay Open Grave coffins along the horde's path and lead the crowd over them; bank as you go.

Name: Madame Marionette
UnlockHint: Beat 10 mission bosses with no failed objectives
TraitText: For 2s after an E or R she takes 20% less damage.
Bio: A puppeteer in a long gown who turns the dead into marionettes and conducts them from afar.
Tip: Cast often - each cast shields her for a moment - and keep her puppets fighting in front of her.

Name: Sir Hollowhead
UnlockHint: Win a mission in under 14 minutes
TraitText: After 2.5s at a run he hits 25% harder.
Bio: A broad, headless knight carrying his lantern-pumpkin head. He rides at everything.
Tip: Keep running to build his gallop; charge in with Head Toss and let the head burst behind you.

Name: Archmage Tickwell
TraitText: For 1.5s after any dash he takes 30% less damage.
Bio: A tiny old wizard with an enormous starry hat, a beard down to his boots and a pocket full of clocks.
Tip: Rewind: step in, fight, press E to snap back out. Dashes make him hard to hurt for a moment.
